fields.description: The row of the file that holds the column headings (1 = first row).
fields.label: Header Row

fields.description: The column headings exactly as they appear in this marketplace's sales report (upper / lower case does not matter).
fields.label: Columns in the Marketplace File

fields.description: One heading, or several joined with + (e.g. order_group_id + sku_code) when the report's own order ID is not unique per line.
fields.label: Order ID Column

fields.description: Line total: the column is the amount for the whole line and is divided by the quantity.
fields.label: Selling Price Is

fields.description: Optional. What the marketplace pays you for the line (e.g. Final Payable), read like the selling price. When set, each line's commission % comes from the file (1 - payout / selling price) instead of the marketplace's commission in Settings.
fields.label: Net Payout Column

fields.description: How dates are written in the file. Auto accepts YYYY-MM-DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY and 05-Oct-2026; Excel date cells always work.
fields.label: Date Format
fields.options:
Auto
YYYY-MM-DD
DD-MM-YYYY
DD/MM/YYYY
MM/DD/YYYY
DD-MMM-YYYY
DD MMM YYYY

fields.description: Optional. Matches each line to the Primary Sales record with this marketplace PO number. Left blank: lines go to the oldest open record that holds the item.
fields.label: PO Number Column

fields.description: Optional. Import only rows whose value in this column is one of the values below (e.g. Order Status).
fields.label: Only Rows Where Column

fields.description: Comma separated, e.g. Delivered, Shipped. Rows with any other value are skipped.
fields.label: Has One Of These Values

fields.description: Customer returns in the same report become Secondary Returns against the sale with the same Order ID. Rows with a negative quantity are always treated as returns.
fields.label: Customer Returns

fields.description: Optional. The column that says whether a line is a sale or a return (e.g. Transaction Type).
fields.label: Transaction Type Column

fields.description: Comma separated values of that column that mean a customer return, e.g. RETURN.
fields.label: Return Values

fields.description: Optional. The date of a return line (e.g. last_modified_on). Left blank: the Sale Date column is used, which in many reports is the original order date.
fields.label: Return Date Column
